name: Reincarnatiopedia Trust Badge
author: reincarnatiopedia

sections.description:
The trust badge helps your clients feel safer.

Reincarnatiopedia is an international directory of past life regression specialists and training centers. Specialists listed in the directory can show the free Trusted Website badge on their own website. A click on the badge opens the specialist’s profile in the directory, where the client sees the confirmed website, training and reviews.

How it works

  1. In your Reincarnatiopedia account, confirm your website (Social networks → Website).
  2. Install this plugin, open Settings → Trust Badge and enter your ReID.
  3. Tick “Show the badge on my website”. Done — the badge appears on every page.

The badge is shown only on the website confirmed in the specialist’s account. If someone enters another person’s ReID on a different website, the badge is not shown. The plugin re-checks once a day: if the website is removed from the account, the badge disappears by itself.

Features

  • Automatic placement: bottom of every page, or floating in a corner.
  • Block for the block editor, classic widget and shortcode [reincarnatiopedia_badge] with optional size and lang attributes, for example [reincarnatiopedia_badge size="180x144" lang="de"].
  • 33 badge languages, English by default.
  • 5 sizes: 480×120, 360×90, 320×80, 240×88, 180×144.
  • No cookies, no tracking scripts, no data about your visitors.

External services

This plugin connects to Reincarnatiopedia (https://reincarnatiopedia.com), the service that issues the badge.

  1. Badge status check. When you save the settings, and then once a day, the plugin requests https://reincarnatiopedia.com/api/badge/status. It sends the ReID you entered and the host name of your website (for example example.com). Nothing else is sent. The answer says whether this website is confirmed in the specialist’s account and gives the profile link.
  2. Badge image. When a visitor opens a page with the badge, the visitor’s browser loads the badge image from https://reincarnatiopedia.com/badges/. As with any image on the web, the server receives the visitor’s IP address and browser details in its standard access log. No cookies are set.

Terms of service: https://reincarnatiopedia.com/legal/#site
Privacy policy: https://reincarnatiopedia.com/legal/#privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip file.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open Settings → Trust Badge, enter your ReID, tick “Show the badge on my website” and save.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my ReID?

In your Reincarnatiopedia account at https://app.reincarnatiopedia.com — it looks like ReID-0000-0000-0001-2345.

The settings say the website is not confirmed

Open your account → Social networks → Website, add the address of this website, place the check code on the page and press “Check”. Then save the plugin settings again.

Is the badge free?

Yes, the basic badge is free.

Can I choose the language?

Yes. English is the default; 33 languages are available in Settings → Trust Badge or with the lang attribute of the shortcode.
